ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity pixels to low-intensity pixels; the surface is predominantly dark (low-intensity) with localized clusters of white/light-grey (high-intensity) pixels representing approximately 15% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dispersed white mottling and speckling concentrated on the medial and distal sections of the left lobe; a thin, high-contrast white linear band follows the trailing edge of the right lobe towards the tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a deep vertical penetration into the fluke body, exhibiting a calculated interior angle of approximately 40-45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge; amplitude of serrations is more pronounced on the left lobe's upper perimeter compared to the right lobe's smoother distal edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The left lobe follows a convex upward curve transitioning to a rounded tip; the right lobe exhibits a more linear, diagonal trajectory towards an tapered distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular white/tan pixel groupings (barnacle colonization) localized on the leading edge tips and intermittently along the trailing edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned light-grey linear streaks (rake marks) visible on the darker surface of the left lobe, primarily oriented in a dorso-ventral direction.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization present along the peripheral boundaries of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Vertical pixel-streaks representing water droplets shedding from the trailing edge in multiple locations.
